items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: So I take in Morton and August.

ctx.x: Well I was going to ask you. Go ahead.

Later on it got to the point, I didn't help all them fellas on the trumpet I got out the band with. I couldn't get no trumpet players at all. They stick with me. Right up. So anyhow, what I did, I take in and... So I said I'm going to break my boys in on the trumpet. And I know they got to play with me whether they want or not. Because I'm the daddy. So I take in Morton and August. And I learned down the trumpet, how to play the trumpet. And I learned trumpet from old man Delmore. And August and Mauret, I often…
